checklist.notes: Requests for help, simple past reference, and the movement sense of run are directly practised in controlled and integrated tasks.
Models, answer explanations, and constrained sentence building support independent correction and reuse.
The set integrates translation, reading, form completion, construction, and listening, but opens with a medium translation before easier scaffolds.
Each task states the expected operation and supplies enough context for a bounded response.
Texts are short and the final listening script combines only previously practised request and past-event content.
A Vietnamese-to-English request task and familiar names provide useful transfer practice without population-wide assumptions.
Two short comprehension tasks plus three controlled tasks are feasible for A1.2.

methods: Reviewed the exercise set and audit against the declared original project-authored policy and external-payload/media declarations.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: No Internet-wide copyright or plagiarism search was performed; this review checked only the declared original project-authored policy and supplied artifact evidence.

findings.description: The set begins with a medium translation task before easier reading, fill-blank, and sentence-construction supports.
findings.recommendation: Move translation after controlled request construction so productive demand rises more gradually.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence, not human review or release approval.
The review covers the supplied immutable exercise set and automated audit; it does not report an Internet-wide originality search.
